summary: First backend test iteration for GEIFEM contact/newsletter/economic-indicators endpoints. All 17 pytest tests passed (100% backend success). Verified MongoDB persistence, validation, idempotency, caching, no _id leakage, and graceful email degradation (Emergent Email proxy returns 401 as expected with placeholder key, endpoints still succeed).

minor.issue: Emergent Email proxy returns 401 Unauthorized (placeholder EMERGENT_EMAIL_KEY). Endpoints degrade gracefully (return success, persist data). Requires platform-provisioned key to enable transactional emails.

action_items: Replace placeholder EMERGENT_EMAIL_KEY with a platform-provisioned key so transactional emails (lead notification + client confirmation + newsletter welcome) are delivered. Endpoints already handle failure gracefully.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~630 lines and mixes routing, HTML templates, external API fetching, and email logic — recommend splitting into modules (routers/, services/email.py, services/indicators.py, templates/) before it grows further.

Logger is defined AFTER helper functions that call logger.warning/error (e.g. _fetch_fx uses logger before it's initialized on line 628). This works because helpers are invoked lazily, but is fragile — move logger init to top of file.
GET /api/contact and GET /api/newsletter are unauthenticated admin endpoints exposing all PII (emails, phones, messages). Recommend adding auth/API key protection before production.
In-memory _indicators_cache is process-local; multi-worker/replica deployments will each hit Alpha Vantage independently and won't share cache. Consider Redis or Mongo-backed cache.
No unique index on newsletter.email → race condition could allow duplicate subscriptions if two identical requests arrive concurrently. Add MongoDB unique index on email (lowercased).
servicio field validated as free-form string (min_length=1). Consider Enum/Literal restriction to the 6 known values used in the HTML template to prevent invalid data.
hard-coded preview URL in _client_confirmation_html (https://premium-corp-site-5.preview.emergentagent.com/insights) — should come from an env var (SITE_URL) so it survives domain changes.
test_credentials: N/A - no auth required for tested endpoints
seed_data_creation: Created a few TEST_-prefixed contact/newsletter entries in MongoDB (contacts and newsletter collections). Safe to leave or purge by prefix TEST_.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All backend endpoints (POST/GET /api/contact, POST/GET /api/newsletter, GET /api/economic-indicators) are green. Reuse /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py for regression. Email delivery via Emergent proxy still returns 401 due to placeholder key — this is EXPECTED and should not be treated as a bug. Frontend integration was NOT tested per instructions.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A - no bugs to RCA. Email 401s are due to placeholder key, not a code defect.
